mark_rule.mark_if: a wallet that paid >= 20 distinct recipients on that UTC day

crawler_spec.population_ref: scope.chain + scope.event + scope.amount_cap_usd, grouped by UTC day (scope.utc_day_boundary)

not_measured.note: Chain data only: whether anything was delivered, and whether a wallet is one buyer, are not determined.

headline.caveat: Sum of daily waterfalls over 6 UTC days, USD-weighted ($34,153 total, $2,256 open-market). Only identified_non_organic_share (contest, crawler probes, closed fleets, one-payment-per-wallet sellers) is asserted non-organic; unclassified_share is sellers below 20 non-crawler wallets that day and likely includes real business customers.
